statement: The CC shall discard all traffic on its radio interface except WireGuard traffic from the provisioned GCS peer.
rationale: Keeps RF-injected MAVLink, including the four messages PX4 accepts unsigned, from reaching the MAVLink router or the FC (THR-001). Verified by VE-01.
resiliency_approach: Segmentation: Predefined Segmentation; Deception: Obfuscation; Coordinated Protection: Calibrated Defense-in-Depth

statement: The GCS shall discard all traffic on its radio interface except WireGuard traffic from the provisioned CC peer.
rationale: Mirrors SR-001 on the ground side: RF-injected traffic and a compromised ground radio reach only the WireGuard endpoint.
resiliency_approach: Segmentation: Predefined Segmentation; Deception: Obfuscation; Coordinated Protection: Calibrated Defense-in-Depth

statement: The FC shall reject MAVLink messages that are unsigned or not signed with the provisioned key, except HEARTBEAT, RADIO_STATUS, ADSB_VEHICLE and COLLISION.
rationale: End-to-end command integrity from GCS to FC, inside the tunnel. The exceptions are PX4's fixed unsigned allowlist. Verified by VE-02.

statement: The FC shall enter Return mode when no GCS heartbeat has been received for COM_DL_LOSS_T = 10 s (NAV_DLL_ACT = 2).
rationale: PX4 disables the GCS-loss failsafe by default. Jamming, tunnel loss and CC failure all appear as data-link loss (DD-01, DD-05). 10 s is the PX4 default timeout, kept as the initial value and checked in VE-01.

statement: The CC shall boot only boot-chain components signed with the project boot key, verified from a hardware root of trust.
rationale: Stops persistent modification of the boot chain from surviving a reboot.

statement: The CC shall mount its root filesystem read-only with block-level integrity verification.
rationale: Extends the verified boot chain to the root filesystem, so offline or runtime modification is detected when blocks are read.
resiliency_approach: Substantiated Integrity: Integrity Checks; Non-Persistence: Non-Persistent Services

statement: The CC shall install only update images that are signed with the MSS release key and newer than the installed version.
rationale: Blocks malicious and rollback images on the maintenance path.
resiliency_approach: Substantiated Integrity: Provenance Tracking; Substantiated Integrity: Integrity Checks

statement: The CC shall restrict read access to the MAVLink signing key to a single signing service.
rationale: Compromise of the video pipeline, the router or another CC process then does not directly yield the shared key.

statement: The CC shall run the MAVLink router, the command filter and the video pipeline as unprivileged processes confined by a mandatory access control policy.
rationale: These processes parse untrusted input from the link and the payload. Confinement limits what an exploited parser can reach.
resiliency_approach: Privilege Restriction: Trust-Based Privilege Management; Segmentation: Predefined Segmentation

statement: The CC shall seal its WireGuard private key and its copy of the signing key to its TPM, bound to the measured boot state.
rationale: Keys cannot be read from removed storage, and a modified boot chain cannot unseal them.
resiliency_approach: Privilege Restriction: Attribute-Based Usage Restriction; Substantiated Integrity: Integrity Checks

statement: The CC shall forward from the GCS tunnel to the FC only messages and commands on the approved allowlist, which excludes SERIAL_CONTROL, FILE_TRANSFER_PROTOCOL, SETUP_SIGNING, RADIO_STATUS, ADSB_VEHICLE and COLLISION.
rationale: Implements DD-04: removes shell, file and key-management services and the unsigned-allowlist messages from what the link can reach. QGroundControl may use MAVLink FTP for component metadata; P4 validates the allowlist against QGroundControl v5.1.5 and records any exception.
resiliency_approach: Realignment: Restriction; Coordinated Protection: Calibrated Defense-in-Depth

statement: The CC shall rate-limit MAVLink traffic forwarded to the FC to the approved per-message rates.
rationale: Keeps a flood, malicious or accidental, from starving FC message handling.

statement: The CC shall log each command it forwards to the FC with a timestamp and either the sending WireGuard peer or a CC-originated marker.
rationale: WireGuard peers have individual keys, so the CC can attribute what MAVLink signing cannot.
resiliency_approach: Analytic Monitoring: Forensic and Behavioral Analysis

statement: The CC shall accept only the USB device classes and identifiers on the approved payload list.
rationale: Blocks a tampered payload from presenting itself as a keyboard, network adapter or storage device.

statement: The CC shall verify the signature of MAVLink frames received from the FC before using them for autonomy decisions.
rationale: Autonomy acts only on telemetry from a key holder.

statement: The CC shall restore C2 forwarding through a hardware watchdog when its C2 services stop responding.
rationale: Shortens a CC hang before the data-link-loss failsafe ends the mission. The watchdog period is set in P4.

statement: The CC shall encrypt stored mission imagery to a public key whose private key is held only on the MSS.
rationale: A captured vehicle holds no key that decrypts its imagery. This follows the PX4 log-encryption design (SR-019).

statement: The FC shall boot only firmware signed with the project firmware key, using PX4 Bootloader Secure Boot.
rationale: Blocks unsigned or modified firmware loaded over USB or from tampered artifacts. PX4's secure boot uses Ed25519 signatures.
resiliency_approach: Substantiated Integrity: Integrity Checks; Substantiated Integrity: Provenance Tracking

statement: The FC shall encrypt flight logs with PX4 log encryption, using a public key whose private key is held only on the MSS.
rationale: PX4 log encryption (XChaCha20 with an RSA2048-OAEP key wrap) is not enabled in default builds, so it is a build requirement.

statement: The FC shall run with the GNSS spoofing and jamming checks enabled (EKF2_GPS_CHECK bits 9 and 11 set).
rationale: PX4 always alerts on receiver-reported spoofing and jamming. With these bits set, a report also fails PX4's GNSS checks on the ground and in flight, so the EKF stops relying on that data and arming is blocked. The default (2047) leaves bit 11 clear. Detection depends on the receiver reporting the condition.
resiliency_approach: Analytic Monitoring: Monitoring and Damage Assessment; Substantiated Integrity: Integrity Checks

statement: The FC shall take no automatic flight action on ADS-B traffic reports (NAV_TRAFF_AVOID = 0 or 1).
rationale: With no ADS-B receiver in the system, any traffic report is spoofed. Return or Land on spoofed traffic would hand an adversary control of when the mission ends.

statement: The FC shall have only the MAVLink instance for the CC link enabled besides USB, with the uXRCE-DDS client disabled (UXRCE_DDS_CFG = 0).
rationale: Implements DD-03: no path to the FC bypasses the CC, and none bypasses signing.

statement: The FC shall carry tamper-evident seals over its SD-card slot, debug connectors and sensor and actuator wiring that are inspected before each flight.
rationale: Physical access is the main threat to the key file and to internal wiring (PX4 hardening guide). Seals make that access evident before flight.

statement: The FC shall have its SWD/JTAG debug port disabled or physically sealed in the flight configuration.
rationale: PX4 notes that exposed debug ports allow a full firmware reflash and bypass all software security.

statement: The GCS shall alert the operator when FC telemetry is unsigned or not signed with the provisioned key.
rationale: Detects a deleted or replaced key file and an adversary-installed first key before flight. Verified as part of VE-02.
resiliency_approach: Analytic Monitoring: Monitoring and Damage Assessment

statement: The GCS shall require individual operator authentication to unlock a session.
rationale: Prevents use of an unattended or stolen GCS, and ties actions to an operator account.

statement: The GCS shall use full-disk encryption.
rationale: Protects the keys and mission data on a lost or stolen laptop.

statement: The GCS shall install only software packages whose signatures verify against the MSS release key.
rationale: Keeps tampered QGroundControl builds and packages off a key holder.

statement: The GCS shall have no network interface enabled other than the ground-radio link during operations.
rationale: The GCS is a key holder. Isolating it removes email, web and other network paths to the keys.

statement: The GCS shall record each sortie's sent and received MAVLink traffic with the operator account that ran it.
rationale: Gives the operator side of command attribution, which complements the CC log (SR-013).
resiliency_approach: Analytic Monitoring: Forensic and Behavioral Analysis

statement: The MSS shall build release artifacts only from dependencies pinned by cryptographic hash to approved sources.
rationale: Defeats typosquatting, dependency confusion and silent upstream changes.

statement: The MSS shall produce an SBOM and a vulnerability scan for every release artifact, including PX4 firmware.
rationale: Tracks upstream advisories, including PX4 MAVLink fixes, against what is actually deployed. PX4 v1.18 generates an SPDX SBOM for each build.

statement: The MSS shall record build provenance for every release artifact and verify it before loading.
rationale: Detects artifacts built outside the controlled pipeline or modified after build.

statement: The MSS shall hold software signing private keys in a hardware security module that does not export them.
rationale: Even a compromised MSS cannot copy the signing keys.

statement: The MSS shall keep an encrypted offline backup of each software signing key.
rationale: Losing a signing key would leave devices unable to accept updates.

statement: The MSS shall provision a new MAVLink signing key to the FC, CC and GCS after any loss of physical custody of a key holder.
rationale: The key is shared and PX4 has no automatic rotation, so one exposed holder exposes all of them.

statement: The MSS shall provision the first signing key on the FC over USB at first power-up, before any other link is connected.
rationale: Closes the provisioning window created by PX4 v1.18 accepting the first key on any link.

statement: The MSS shall process offloaded vehicle data in an account that has no access to key material.
rationale: Data returned from the vehicle is untrusted input to the host that holds every key.

statement: The MSS shall log each software load and key-provisioning action with the maintainer's identity.
rationale: Makes maintenance actions attributable.
resiliency_approach: Analytic Monitoring: Forensic and Behavioral Analysis

statement: The MSS shall require individual maintainer authentication.
rationale: Prevents use of an unattended MSS and supports SR-039.

statement: The MSS shall record the firmware versions of the GNSS module, ESCs, radios and payload at each maintenance action and compare them with the approved baseline.
rationale: Detects peripheral firmware changed through maintenance or replacement parts.

statement: The MSS shall provision GCS keys over a direct wired connection and never through removable media.
rationale: Removes the copy of the keys that removable media would leave behind.

statement: The MSS shall generate and provision keys only while disconnected from external networks.
rationale: Separates key handling from the online upstream intake (DF-16).

statement: The CC shall accept maintenance connections only when authenticated with the MSS maintenance key.
rationale: Stops a rogue device on the maintenance port from loading images or credentials.
